notes.title: 🔥 v1.1 and French translation! 🇫🇷
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539593/6151ce368a31252be83cfe1564178ac1ecf5d8a1.png[/img]
Heya!

This is the first major update of the game, with the complete localization and translation of the game in French.

[i]Bienvenue les francophones. J’espère que vous allez apprécier le jeu.[/i]

As a native French speaker, it was important to me to transcribe to the best of my abilities the mood and the feelings I wanted to convey with Univocity. I hope I did a good job!

This update also comes with some modifications:
[list]
[*]Intro text has been changed from displayables to actual dialogue text, so it’s now clickable, replayable, and shows up in the history.
[*]Minor dialogue changes, coming from working on the translation.
[/list]
Enjoy!
